question: On the same original V1.7 12H Monday reclaim, does skipping only closes that remain beyond both EMAs against the trade preserve more of the original account's upside?
single_variable: Run the previously fixed three-way cloud-location classification as (inside or trend-side) versus only the opposite-side group. selection: POST HOC: the prior original-timing study showed only 797U of net cash from the 727 opposite-side closes in the full reference account. That attribution motivated this follow-up comparison; the chronological panels are descriptive and are not untouched validation.
